--- export_data_query.sql
EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = "gs://bucket/output.csv", format = "csv") AS
SELECT 1 AS value

--- AST
&ast.ExportData{
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 12,
    Rparen:  67,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 21,
          NameEnd: 24,
          Name:    "uri",
        },
        Value: &ast.StringLiteral{
          ValuePos: 27,
          ValueEnd: 51,
          Value:    "gs://bucket/output.csv",
        },
      },
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 53,
          NameEnd: 59,
          Name:    "format",
        },
        Value: &ast.StringLiteral{
          ValuePos: 62,
          ValueEnd: 67,
          Value:    "csv",
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Query: &ast.QueryStatement{
    Query: &ast.Select{
      Select:  72,
      Results: []ast.SelectItem{
        &ast.Alias{
          Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
            ValuePos: 79,
            ValueEnd: 80,
            Base:     10,
            Value:    "1",
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    81,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 84,
              NameEnd: 89,
              Name:    "value",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = "gs://bucket/output.csv", format = "csv") AS SELECT 1 AS value
